events.verdict: Diabate (CHA) brings his hand to Anunoby's (NYK) upper body, and the contact as Diabate releases away is marginal.
McBride (NYK) applies his forearm to Micic's (CHA) body, which he immediately removes as Micic begins his upward shooting motion.
Diabate (CHA) cleanly deflects the ball away from Towns (NYK) as they pursue the rebound.
Hart (NYK) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Hornets.
Miller (CHA) releases the inbounds pass within five seconds.
Micic (CHA) briefly grasps Hart's (NYK) arm at the start of the drive, and releases his arm without impacting his ability to defend.
Towns (NYK) cleanly deflects the ball away from Diabate (CHA).
Diabaté (CHA) is in the lane for less than three seconds when the ball is touched by an opponent.  Once the Hornets regain possession, he receives the ball in the lane and immediately shoots.
Diabaté (CHA) keeps his foot planted to the floor and does not intentionally kick the ball on the play.
Towns (NYK) is firming up in Micic's (CHA) path and he absorbs the contact to his upper body.
Towns (NYK) establishes a screening position in Green's (CHA) path and absorbs the contact to his upper body prior to any lower body contact occurring.
Diabate (CHA) steps forward towards Brunson (NYK) and initiates contact with Brunson's lower body that affects his follow through.
Brunson (NYK) swipes his hand down and initiates contact with Diabate's (CHA) arm as he defends the shot near the rim.
Brunson (NYK) grabs and holds Martin's (CHA) arm, which affects his ability to secure the rebound with both hands.

Following the successful free throw by Martin (CHA), the Knicks do not yet have the ball at their disposal to inbound when contact occurs between Towns (NYK) and Green (CHA).  By rule, the officials may not call an offensive foul on this play because the ball is dead and not in possession of the offensive team.
Green (CHA) is moving alongside Brunson's (NYK) path as he defends the driving shot attempt, and the contact is marginal.
Towns (NYK) is firming up in Green's (CHA) path and he absorbs the contact to his upper body.
Salaun (CHA) commits a take foul on Brunson (NYK).
Anunoby (NYK) briefly grasps Miller's (CHA) jersey off ball during the inbound.
Anunoby (NYK) initiates contact with Miller's (CHA) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Salaun (CHA) and Hart (NYK) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Martin (CHA) commits a take foul on Brunson (NYK).
Martin (CHA) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Miller (CHA) releases the ball prior to stepping out of bounds.
Anunoby (NYK) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Hornets.
McBride (NYK) legally contests Green's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
